clue.text: Sustain the new devotee

indicators.note: new signals that the letters of these two words are made into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone who keeps the novice going.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' tells you to rearrange the letters of SUSTAIN THE.
explanation.definitionFit: A devotee is a keen follower, a fan of something.

clue.text: Greek character, an engineer, offering a suggestion

parts.note: nu is the thirteenth letter of the Greek alphabet
taken as written
CE stands for civil engineer

explanation.surface: A Greek fellow and an engineer put forward an idea.
explanation.definitionFit: A subtle hint or slight shade of meaning is a suggestion.

clue.text: A capital executor!

parts.note: capital reads as excellent, but the executor carries out capital punishment by removing heads

explanation.definitionFit: An executioner who beheads people carries out the capital sentence.

clue.text: Regular check into a city's organization

indicators.note: into says one piece goes inside the other
organization signals that the letters of a city's are organized into a new order

parts.note: to stem a flow is to check it

explanation.surface: A routine inspection of how a city is run.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organization' rearranges A CITY'S (counting the S of the possessive) into SYSATIC, and 'into' puts STEM inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something methodical follows a regular plan.

clue.text: A game cut short

parts.note: bridge is a card game

explanation.surface: A match abandoned before the end.
explanation.definitionFit: To shorten a text by condensing it is to cut it short.

clue.text: Relation given tin-opener and beer

indicators.note: the opener of a word is its first letter, here of tin

parts.note: ale is a kind of beer

explanation.surface: A relative given a can opener and a pint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Relation' looks like a family member, but it means a story told.
explanation.definitionFit: A story is a relation, an account of events.

clue.text: Old patriarch has collection of pictures to put up

parts.note: Levi is a patriarch of the Old Testament, a son of Jacob
the Tate is the London art gallery and its collection

explanation.surface: An ancient patriarch hanging his art collection.
explanation.walkthrough: The TATE is a famous art gallery in London.
explanation.definitionFit: To rise or raise into the air as if by magic is to be put up.

clue.text: Read little maybe — badly handled

indicators.note: maybe suggests these letters might form something else, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone who perhaps reads too little was roughly treated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maybe' tells you to rearrange READ LITTLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Abused or mistreated means badly handled.

clue.text: Make a request for a copper ring

parts.note: a copper coin is a penny, abbreviated P
a peal is a ringing of bells

explanation.surface: Asking for a copper bell to be rung.
explanation.definitionFit: To plead earnestly is to make a request.

clue.text: A worrier, a right fool, in a woman's clutches

indicators.note: clutches pictures the woman's word gripping the other pieces inside it

parts.note: her is the possessive for a woman
an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: A nagging, foolish man is held fast by a woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who pesters and torments others is a worrier.

clue.text: The dreamer gives some thought to a catalogue

parts.note: an idea is a thought
a list is a catalogue

explanation.surface: A fanciful person considers a sales catalogue.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with lofty visions of perfection is a dreamer.

clue.text: About a thousand and twenty quires

parts.note: re means about or concerning
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: Roughly a thousand and twenty quires of paper.
explanation.definitionFit: A paper measure equal to twenty quires, or 480 or 500 sheets.

clue.text: They record people's comings and goings

definitions.text: They record people's comings and goings

parts.words: They record people's comings and goings
parts.note: comings and goings sound like travel, but here they are births and deaths, which officials enter in registers

explanation.definitionFit: Officials who register births and deaths log arrivals into and departures from life.

clue.text: His is a trying occupation

parts.note: trying sounds like exhausting, but here it means hearing cases in court

explanation.definitionFit: A justice of the peace tries cases in court, so the work is literally trying.

clue.text: Make a song about a parent being overwhelming

indicators.note: about says the first piece goes around the second

parts.note: to sing is to make a song
a mother is a parent

explanation.surface: Someone making a fuss about a mother being too much.
explanation.definitionFit: Suffocating attention is overwhelming.

clue.text: Stone jar with nickel lining

indicators.note: lining says the second piece sits inside the first like a lining

parts.note: to grate on someone is to jar
Ni is the chemical symbol for nickel

explanation.surface: A stone pot with a metal lining.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jar' looks like a container but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A hard igneous rock is a building stone.

clue.text: A mild strike measure taken if really necessary

parts.note: a tap is a light blow
an inch is a measure of length

explanation.surface: A gentle industrial action taken only when needed.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means in an emergency, if there is no alternative.

clue.text: "X" gets left outside — a bad sign

indicators.note: outside says the left piece goes around the other

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship
X is the Roman numeral for ten

explanation.surface: A cross left outside is an ill omen.
explanation.definitionFit: An omen of something momentous, often ominous, is a bad sign.

clue.text: Liberal constituents rattle on

indicators.note: constituents treats the letters of rattle on as parts to be reassembled

explanation.surface: Liberal voters keep chattering on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'constituents' tells you the letters of RATTLE ON are parts to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Broad-minded and accepting means liberal.

clue.text: A man concerned about religious instruction, as Barkis was

indicators.note: about says the first piece goes around the second

parts.note: a carer is a man concerned for others' welfare
RI is short for religious instruction, a school subject

explanation.surface: A caring man worried about religious lessons, like a Dickens character.
explanation.walkthrough: Barkis, in Dickens's David Copperfield, is a carrier who carts goods.
explanation.definitionFit: Barkis works as a carter of goods and parcels in the novel.

clue.text: At one time on the road, now appearing in "Cinderella"

definitions.text: At one time on the road

explanation.definitionFit: A horse-drawn coach once ran on roads; in the pantomime it is a coach on stage.

clue.text: Charge the boy seen carrying duck

indicators.note: carrying says the boy holds the other piece inside

parts.note: a lad is a boy
a duck in cricket is a score of nought, O

explanation.surface: Blame the lad who was seen holding a duck.
explanation.definitionFit: A charge is a load, as in a gun or a burden.

clue.text: Enthusiasm makes the academician turn sullen

indicators.note: turn says the academician's letters are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician
dour means sullen

explanation.surface: Keenness makes the Royal Academy member go sulky.
explanation.definitionFit: Passionate zeal is enthusiasm.

clue.text: Beasts responsible for the present transport system

definitions.text: Beasts responsible for the present transport system

parts.words: Beasts responsible for the present transport system
parts.note: present sounds like current, but it is a gift, carried on Christmas Eve by animals pulling a sleigh

explanation.definitionFit: Father Christmas's sleigh is pulled by antlered animals delivering gifts.

clue.text: Looked at some grey Edwardian clothes

indicators.note: some says only part of the words grey Edwardian is used

explanation.surface: Admired some grey Edwardian clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: To watch or regard something is to have looked at it.

clue.text: Copier, one with German roll-back

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
mit is German for with

indicators.note: back says the roll's letters run in the reverse direction

parts.note: a rota is a roll or list of duties

explanation.surface: A copycat with a German rollback.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who mimics another is a copier.

clue.text: Say one's piece?

parts.note: say one's piece means speak one's mind, but here it means deliver a memorized poem

explanation.definitionFit: To deliver a learned passage aloud from memory.

clue.text: Rode gray to work — how lowering!

indicators.note: to work something is to shape it, so these letters are reworked into a new order

explanation.surface: An unflattering account of riding a grey horse.
explanation.definitionFit: Disparaging remarks are lowering, belittling someone.
